response.text: {"label": "misread_spec", "reason": "The target needs a 3C word held pending with tready low and then accepted during a later bad frame's frame_error strobe (gold `154 ... rx hs 3c` together with `154 ... rx frame_error 1`), but the sub ties tready high and sends the bad frame before the 3C frame, so it only logs `382 ... rx frame_error 1` and `762 ... rx frame_error 1` with no 3c handshake."}
